summary.headline: The Tricentennial Committee estimated a $200,000 celebration budget and planned collaborations with local youth sports and town organizations.
summary.summary: The Tricentennial Committee reviewed progress across numerous planned events for the town's upcoming 300th anniversary celebration. Friends of Southborough 300 reported having approximately $150,000 to $164,000 in available and pledged funds, with the committee aligning on an overall working target of around $200,000. Members also coordinated with Algonquin Baseball and Softball on opening day outreach, advanced plans for historical tours, and formally voted to add a winter lights event to the celebration schedule.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes from March 11, 2026, with minor textual corrections. Members also handled procedural scheduling and meeting room logistics.
key_details: Approved March 11 minutes with minor revisions.

topics.title: Status updates on school and community anniversary events
topics.summary: The committee reviewed progress on school-hosted events and local community coordination. St. Mark's School and Fay School are advancing plans for historical campus tours and a children's family day, respectively. The committee also noted upcoming coordination with local historical groups and Nipmuc tribal representatives regarding parade participation.
key_details: St. Mark's School will host public historical walking tours utilizing student guides and faculty storytellers.
Fay School agreed to cover material and snack costs for a dedicated family day event.
Committee discussed adapting town historical content into a potential children's booklet.
Organizers are coordinating with Native American museum contacts in Devens regarding parade representation.
topics.outcome: Updates received with planning to continue through designated working groups.

topics.title: History Makers recognition program
topics.summary: Members discussed a draft nomination form and guidelines for a proposed History Makers initiative. The program aims to honor notable past and present Southborough figures across 15 categories, with recognitions featured online and in the anniversary parade.
key_details: Eligibility will focus on residents and former residents, excluding non-resident employees from receiving community awards.
Honorees will receive ribbon awards and an invitation to walk together in the parade.
Final nomination forms are scheduled for completion in May, with public nominations running from September to November 2026.
Announcements of selected honorees are slated to roll out starting in January 2027.
topics.outcome: Committee agreed to finalize nomination forms in May and launch nominations in fall 2026.

topics.title: Baseball and softball opening day collaboration
topics.summary: The committee met with the president of Algonquin Baseball and Softball to discuss partnership opportunities. The league agreed to host a Tricentennial promotional table during its official opening day ceremonies on May 2, 2026, at Mooney Field.
key_details: Opening day ceremonies take place May 2, 2026, with a parade at 11:00 AM and games running until 8:30 PM.
The committee will set up an informational table to sell commemorative bricks and distribute event flyers.
The league and committee discussed future anniversary tie-ins for 2027, such as ceremonial first pitches and homerun derby events.
topics.outcome: The committee will coordinate with league volunteers to finalize table placement and staffing for May 2.

topics.title: Fundraising and overall celebration budget preview
topics.summary: Friends of Southborough 300 provided a detailed financial report and worked with the committee to establish rough budget caps for major planned anniversary events. Combining major donor pledges, commemorative brick sales, and a town appropriation, approximately $150,000 to $164,000 is currently accounted for against a target budget of $200,000.
key_details: Friends of Southborough 300 secured $100,000 in major donor pledges, two at $25,000 and five at $10,000.
Commemorative brick sales have generated over $34,000 in gross receipts (roughly $30,000 net after vendor fees).
Target budgets allocated include $50,000 for the parade, $30,000 for the opening day drone show, $20,000 for the firefighter muster, and $20,000 for signage and marketing.
The overall celebration budget target was agreed at $200,000, leaving about $25,000 to $35,000 remaining to raise.
topics.outcome: The committee and fundraising group agreed on a $200,000 working target budget for anniversary events.
topics.why_it_matters: Determines the scale and town-wide funding required for multi-day 300th anniversary events and civic celebrations.

topics.title: GloSoBo winter light celebration
topics.summary: The committee reviewed plans to create a new winter festival called GloSoBo (Celebrating Generations of Light). The evening event is envisioned as a secular, winter-themed celebration featuring building lights, wreaths, projectors, and entertainment, proposed for Friday, December 3, 2027.
key_details: Planned for the Southborough town center with white lights, wreaths, illuminated displays, and hot refreshments.
Tentatively scheduled for Friday, December 3, 2027, from 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM to avoid conflict with weekend holiday events.
The event carries an estimated budget ceiling of approximately $10,000.
topics.outcome: The committee voted 5-0 to formally include GloSoBo in the official Tricentennial calendar.

topics.title: Town Meeting handout and outreach materials
topics.summary: Members finalized a one-page handout to distribute at the upcoming Annual Town Meeting to inform residents about scheduled anniversary events and solicit volunteers.
key_details: Approved text updates including school tours, muster dates, and contact information.
Copies will be made available on the entrance tables at Town Meeting.
Promotional banners will be displayed outside the venue.
topics.outcome: The committee voted 5-0 to approve the Town Meeting handout with noted revisions.

votes.motion: Incorporate the GloSoBo celebration of light into the Tricentennial calendar of events.
Approve the informational handout for Annual Town Meeting as edited.
